description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database visualizer interface. It defines the structure, styles, and client-side JavaScript for browsing databases, tables, and viewing table data with interactive features.
external_methods: fetchData (fetch API call for retrieving data)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands/collapses a database to show or hide its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data entries for a selected table and renders it.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates table cell content with handling for long text and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for detailed view.
